description: Build the Organization Home page the MRQ-203 nav row points at (Organization group: Home · People CRM · Outreach · Settings). Design contract: prototypes/pipeline-v1.1 v1.15 #org/home + sequence/org-settings-design.md iteration 3 (green-lit by Atin 2026-08-14). A composition, not a system: (1) conferences as seasons — every event with dates/state/headline stats, live one opens /dashboard, plus create; (2) the attention strip — outreach follow-ups overdue (from the next-touch data MRQ-205 builds), seats scoped to ended conferences (governance ticket), server connection state (existing instance status) — each line links to its surface, and each source that does not exist yet renders an honest empty, never a fake number; (3) relationship KPIs — people count, returning speakers (2+ conferences via participations), in-outreach count, organizer count; (4) recent org activity (audit_log, newest 4) linking to the full Activity lens. Server-side queries, R7 budgets apply. MRQ-207 is building the org-settings shell in parallel: mount Home at its own route (per prototype: org home is a page, not a settings tab) so there is no shell dependency.
title: Organization Home: the between-conferences view
